question: In May 2025, who has been appointed as the Chief Justice of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai** was appointed as the **Chief Justice of India (CJI) in May 2025**. He succeeded the outgoing Chief Justice, as per the established system of seniority in the Supreme Court of India.
 
• Justice Gavai, born on **24 November 1960**, hails from **Nagpur, Maharashtra**, and has had an illustrious career in the Indian judiciary.
 
• He was elevated to the **Supreme Court of India** on **24 May 2019** and has contributed significantly to various landmark judgments during his tenure.
 
• Justice Gavai became the **second Chief Justice of India from the Scheduled Caste community**, following Justice K.G. Balakrishnan.
 
• His tenure as the **50th Chief Justice of India** is expected to focus on furthering judicial reforms and ensuring timely justice delivery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chief Justice of India (CJI):**

 
 
• The **Chief Justice of India** is the head of the **Supreme Court of India**, the highest judicial forum and final court of appeal under the Constitution of India.
 
• The CJI is appointed by the **President of India** based on the principle of seniority among the judges of the Supreme Court.
 
• The CJI plays a crucial role in allocating cases to judges and managing the overall functioning of the judiciary in India.
 
• The tenure of the CJI depends on the **age of retirement, which is 65 years** for Supreme Court judges.
 
 
 
• **Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai's Early Career:**
 
 
• Justice Gavai started his legal practice in **1985** at the Nagpur Bench of the Bombay High Court.
 
• He was appointed as a **Judge of the Bombay High Court** on **14 November 2003**.
 
• He served as the acting Chief Justice of the Bombay High Court before being elevated to the **Supreme Court of India**.
 
 
 
• **Notable Judgments by Justice Gavai:**
 
 
• Justice Gavai has been part of key judgments related to **constitutional law, criminal law, and civil rights**.
 
• One of his important contributions includes rulings on **environmental protection** and addressing issues of public interest.
 
 
 
• **Importance of the Chief Justice of India:**
 
 
• The CJI ensures the **independence of the judiciary** and upholds the Constitution of India.
 
• The CJI also advises the President in judicial appointments and other significant matters under Article **124(2)** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• He/she has the responsibility of maintaining the highest standards of judicial ethics and integrity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Judicial Appointments:**

 
 
• The appointment of judges to the Supreme Court and High Courts is governed by the **Collegium System**, which consists of the CJI and a group of senior judges.
 
• This system ensures **transparency and merit-based selection** of judges.
 
 
 
• **Scheduled Caste Representation:**
 
 
• Justice Gavai's appointment as the CJI underscores the importance of **inclusivity** and representation of marginalized communities in the judiciary.
 
• It highlights the judiciary's commitment to **diversity** and equal opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Judicial Reforms:**
 
 
• Justice Gavai's tenure is expected to focus on **reducing case pendency** and improving the efficiency of the judicial system.
 
• He is likely to emphasize the use of **technology** in courts to enhance accessibility and transparency.
